aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, including fatal prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide staging criteria for advanced disease.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Among 288,268 men with average follow-up of nine years, 23,281 prostate cancer cases (18,934 nonadvanced and 2,930 advanced including 725 fatal cases) were identified.
study_design: Prospective cohort study with baseline dietary assessment, cancer-registry linkage, and Cox proportional hazards analysis.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Among 288,268 men with average follow-up of nine years, 23,281 prostate cancer cases (18,934 nonadvanced and 2,930 advanced including 725 fatal cases) were identified.
reason: The abstract reports total incident prostate cancer and prospectively ascertained advanced and fatal incident prostate cancer. Advanced disease is the broad aggressive endpoint, with fatal cases included within it.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Eicosapentanoic acid (EPA) intake was related to decreased risk of fatal prostate cancer (HRQ5 vs. Q1, 0.82; 95% CI, 0.64-1.04; Ptrend = 0.02).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns fatal prostate cancer incidence, an aggressive endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: α-Linolenic acid (ALA) intake was related to increased risk of advanced prostate cancer (HRQ5 vs. Q1, 1.17; 95% CI, 1.04-1.31; Ptrend = 0.01).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns advanced incident prostate cancer. Although the supplied row lists all 23,281 cases, the relevant aggressive case count is 2,930 advanced cases.
